# External-data provenance

`zhang_fig13_transcription.csv` contains numeric observations transcribed by the
authors from figure labels in Fig. 13 of:

R. Zhang, J. Zhou, J. Ren, Q. Qi, and Y. Xu, “Inverse tolerance design method
of thin-walled blades in multi-stage machining process,” *Results in
Engineering*, 31, 111604 (2026). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rineng.2026.111604

This is a secondary label-to-label transcription. The `F13_01`–`F13_15`
identifiers were assigned by the package authors solely for traceability; they
are not specimen identifiers from the source publication. The source image and
other copyrighted artwork are not redistributed.
